title: Construction enumeration answer
description: Structured-decoding contract for the enumeration stage (D20). The model returns every construction the paper describes as a 'constructions' array; each element carries a name, a verbatim supporting quote, a class (strategy|auxiliary), and optional grid metadata. Class membership + verbatim locatability are enforced downstream by the lister; this schema pins the shape.

name.description: The paper's own name for the construction.

class.description: 'strategy' spawns a spec; 'auxiliary' is a recorded control/input.

is_grid.description: True iff a parameter sweep of one signal concept (D20 grid rule).

headline_cell.description: The featured cell the spec is built at (required when is_grid).

cells_noted.description: The other sweep cells, recorded as metadata (never separate strategies).
